description: Debian server fleet overview. Cluster and server selectors are populated from Prometheus labels, including UCPIN, UCDEMO, and UCPMED.

panels.description: Days until the first application certificate expires. Let's Encrypt renews at 30 days left; the alert fires at 10 days.
panels.title: Soonest Certificate Expiry

panels.description: Application URLs whose certificate expires within 10 days (the SslCertExpiringIn10Days alert threshold).
panels.title: Expiring Within 10 Days

panels.description: URLs that cannot complete a valid TLS handshake: expired, untrusted or wrong-name certificate, or the site is unreachable. Tahseel is not counted while its tunnel is pending.
panels.title: Failing TLS Checks

panels.description: Application URLs with a certificate reading in the last scrape (of 8).
panels.title: URLs Reporting

panels.description: One row per cluster application URL (all 8), fully verified: expiry, trusted chain, name match. Sorted by days left; red = under 10 days (alert). Tahseel shows TUNNEL PENDING until the uc01 SSH tunnel forwards port 443. Targets: prometheus/targets/ssl/urls.json.

targets.expr: max by (project, domain, instance) (probe_success{job="ssl_cert_url", reachable!~"no|pending"}) or max by (project, domain, instance) (probe_success{job="ssl_cert_url", reachable=~"no|pending"} * 0 - 1)
